summary: All 14 selected items carry concrete, verifiable claims and are kept. Three items cover the OpenAI/Hugging Face attack from genuinely distinct angles (Dwarkesh's narrative reconstruction, Collison's meta-observation on coverage, Bryan's METR/Redwood safety analysis), so they are flagged as same_topic_distinct_angle rather than redundant. No same-event duplicates warrant removal. No replacements needed; no additional Twitter searches requested.
